info.title: Mapping Hub API
info.description: Backend for the web editor, mobile collector and public data hub. GeoJSON everywhere in EPSG:4326; IDs are UUIDs; timestamps are UTC ISO 8601; lists use `?limit=&cursor=` and return `{items, next_cursor}`; errors are `{type, title, status, detail, fields?}`.

post.description: Rotating refresh tokens. Presenting an already-used token revokes the whole session family.
Invite by email. Existing users join immediately; others get an invitation that is accepted when they register.

patch.description: `user_id` is a user id, or an invitation id for pending invites.
Edits the working draft. Collectors keep using the last published version until you publish again.

post.description: Freeze the draft as the next version. Older versions stay readable and keep validating older features.

schema.title: Response List Versions Forms  Form Id  Versions Get

patch.description: 409 `conflict` responses carry `server` and `client` so the app can offer a choice.

post.description:
Bulk import (for example output from KoboToolbox, ODK or QField). Rows are validated against the form;
bad rows are reported in the job result and good rows are kept.

Up to 200 changes. Every change gets its own result; one bad change never fails the batch.
Retrying a change with the same change_id is safe.

get.description:
Changes by anyone, in per-project sequence order. Store `next_cursor` and ask again from there.
Deleted features arrive with `op: delete` (and deleted_at set). Your own changes come back too.

Everything needed to work offline: published forms, project settings and the features in the user's
assigned area (or the whole project if no area is assigned). The cursor is read before the features, so
nothing changed in between can be missed.

post.description:
Photos upload separately from their feature, so a feature never waits for its photos. Calling this
again with the same id returns a fresh URL (use it to resume after a dropped connection).

Returns presigned multipart URLs. PUT each part straight to storage, collect the ETag response
headers, then call /imagery/{id}/complete.
Same as the project upload, for a standalone map you own.

get.description: Mapbox Vector Tile, layer name `features`, attributes: id, status, version, props (JSON text).

Map layer list with stable tile URLs. Each URL carries a short-lived `sig`; call this again when
`expires_in` runs out and update the source's tile URL.
Public catalogue. No login needed; signed-in users also see private datasets of their projects.

GeoJSON FeatureCollection from the immutable snapshot (latest version unless `version` is given).
Page with `next_cursor`; `bbox` filters spatially.

post.description:
Creates the dataset and queues its first snapshot (version 1). Poll the job, then the dataset appears
in the catalogue. Only approved features are included unless `statuses` says otherwise.
Take a fresh snapshot as the next version. Earlier versions never change.

Start an export of one dataset version. Poll GET /jobs/{id} for the signed download URL. Identical
exports are generated once and reused.

get.description:
Progress, and when done the result. Export jobs return a signed `download_url` (valid one hour).
Exports of public datasets can be polled without logging in.

Everything to draw under the features: URL sources plus uploaded imagery that is ready. Uploaded imagery tile
URLs carry a short-lived `sig`; call this again when `expires_in` runs out.

schema.title: Response List Features Maps  Map Id  Features Get

post.description:
Bulk-add features (the browser reads GeoJSON, KML or GPX and sends the features). Invalid ones are skipped
and reported; the rest are added.

file.title: File
file.description: GeoJSON (.geojson/.json), CSV, KML, GPX, GeoPackage, GML or a zipped Shapefile (.zip)

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: JSON object: source column/property -> form field id

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Start /sync/pull from here after loading the bundle

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True if there were more features than the bundle limit; pull from cursor 0 instead

form_version.title: Form Version
form_version.description: Defaults to the latest published version

version.title: Version
version.description: Latest published version, 0 if never published

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Any raster format GDAL reads: tif, tiff, jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif, bmp, jp2, j2k, img, asc

bounds.title: Bounds
bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] in `crs`. Only used when the file has no coordinates of its own (typical for plain JPEG/PNG). Ignored for georeferenced files.

result.title: Result
result.description: Exports include a signed download_url when done

url.title: Url
url.description: Web-size image once processed, otherwise the original

assigned_area.title: Assigned Area
assigned_area.description: GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon limiting the offline bundle

id.title: Id
id.description: user id for active members, invitation id for pending invites

role.title: Role
role.description: The caller's role in this project

url.title: Url
url.description: Tile URL template with {z}, {x} and {y}, e.g. https://example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png

change_id.title: Change Id
change_id.description: Client-generated per change; makes retries idempotent

client_updated_at.title: Client Updated At
client_updated_at.description: Display only; never used for ordering

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Always set: store it and pass it back as ?cursor=

server.description: On conflict: the server's current feature

client.title: Client
client.description: On conflict: what the client tried to write
